blocks.explanation:
Neeche teen mukhtalif linear factors hain aur upar sirf degree 1: yeh proper fraction hai, Case I.
Humein teen fractions chahiyein, constants \(A\), \(B\), \(C\) ke saath.
Plan: identity likhenge, \(x = 1, -2, -3\) rakh kar teenon constants nikalenge, coefficients se tasdeeq, aur aakhir mein jor kar dekhenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{2x + 1}{(x - 1)(x + 2)(x + 3)}\)
Maloom karna hai: is ke partial fractions.
Tareeqa: Case I. Teenon mukhtalif linear factors ko ek ek fraction milega. Har factor ka zero identity mein rakhne se ek constant seedha mil jata hai, kyunke baaqi do terms zero ho jate hain.

Check karein ke fraction proper hai
Upar degree 1, neeche degree 3.
Kyun: \(1 < 3\), is liye fraction proper hai aur division ki zaroorat nahi. Neeche ke teen brackets multiply karein to \(x^3\) banta hai, isi liye degree 3.

Shakal likhein
\[\dfrac{2x + 1}{(x - 1)(x + 2)(x + 3)}\]
\[= \dfrac{A}{x - 1} + \dfrac{B}{x + 2} + \dfrac{C}{x + 3}\]
Kyun: Har mukhtalif linear factor ke liye ek fraction, aur har fraction ke upar sirf ek number (constant). Teen factors, teen constants: ginti denominator ki degree ke barabar.

Denominators hata kar identity banayein
\[2x + 1 = A(x + 2)(x + 3)\]
\[+ B(x - 1)(x + 3)\]
\[+ C(x - 1)(x + 2) \quad (i)\]
Kyun: Dono taraf poore denominator \((x - 1)(x + 2)(x + 3)\) se multiply kiya. Har constant ke saath woh do factors reh gaye jo us ke apne fraction ke neeche nahi the.

\(A\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = 1\) rakhein
\[2(1) + 1 = A(3)(4)\]
\[3 = 12A\]
\[A = \tfrac{1}{4}\]
Kyun: \(x = 1\) par \(x - 1 = 0\), aur yeh factor \(B\) aur \(C\) dono terms mein maujood hai, is liye dono ghayab. \(1 + 2 = 3\) aur \(1 + 3 = 4\).

\(C\) nikalein: (i) mein \(x = -3\) rakhein
\[2(-3) + 1 = C(-4)(-1)\]
\[-5 = 4C\]
\[C = -\tfrac{5}{4}\]
Kyun: \(x + 3 = 0\) par sirf \(C\) bachta hai.
Dhyan dein: \((-4)(-1) = +4\); do minus mil kar plus bante hain. Yahan jaldi mein \(-4\) likh dena aam ghalti hai.

Coefficients compare karein
(i) ko kholein to:
\[x^2:\ A + B + C = 0\]
\[\tfrac{1}{4} + 1 - \tfrac{5}{4} = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[\text{const}:\ 6A - 3B - 2C = 1\]
\[\tfrac{6}{4} - 3 + \tfrac{10}{4} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Baayen taraf \(2x + 1\) mein \(x^2\) hai hi nahi, is liye daayen taraf ke \(x^2\) coefficients ka jama 0 hona chahiye. Constants brackets ke aakhri numbers ke zarb se aate hain: \(2 \cdot 3 = 6\), \((-1)(3) = -3\), \((-1)(2) = -2\). Dono checks sahi, to constants pakke.

Jawab likhein
\[= \dfrac{1}{4(x - 1)} + \dfrac{1}{x + 2} - \dfrac{5}{4(x + 3)}\]
Kyun: \(A = \tfrac{1}{4}\), \(B = 1\), \(C = -\tfrac{5}{4}\) shakal mein rakh diye. Fraction wale constant ka denominator neeche bracket ke saath likhna saaf lagta hai.

Tasdeeq: fractions wapas jor kar dekhein
Common denominator \(4(x - 1)(x + 2)(x + 3)\) par numerator:
\[(x + 2)(x + 3) + 4(x - 1)(x + 3)\]
\[- 5(x - 1)(x + 2)\]
\[= (x^2 + 5x + 6) + (4x^2 + 8x - 12)\]
\[- (5x^2 + 5x - 10)\]
\[= 8x + 4 = 4(2x + 1)\]
To jama \(\dfrac{2x + 1}{(x - 1)(x + 2)(x + 3)}\) hai \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: 4 upar neeche cancel ho gaya aur asal fraction wapas mil gaya. \(x^2\) wale terms \(1 + 4 - 5 = 0\) ho kar ghayab hue, bilkul jaise hona chahiye tha.
